name: Halloween
sources: Cinemeta (v3-cinemeta.strem.io) for ids, titles and dates
notes: One continuity: John Carpenter's Halloween (1978) and its direct sequels Halloween (2018), Halloween Kills and Halloween Ends, which ignore every other film. The other timelines (II-VI, H20/Resurrection, Rob Zombie's remakes) are left out, and so is the TMDB Halloween collection, which mixes them all.
